rationale: Basement flood caused by policyholder's own plumbing failure results in damage to the home's structure (hardwood floors, drywall) and contents, which is covered property damage to the insured dwelling.
claim_summary: Sam Patel's basement flooded due to plumbing failure while policyholder was away on a work trip. Two inches of standing water caused significant damage: hardwood floors buckled, drywall soaked to approximately one foot, and stored boxes destroyed. High-severity claim likely exceeding coverage deductible ($500) and requiring prompt inspection to assess full scope and prevent secondary damage.

case_facts.water_depth: approximately two inches across entire basement
case_facts.damage_description: hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked to approximately one foot height, stored boxes ruined
